port_notes: Upstream 6.0.0 adds menu entries that launch a separate pulchra_chat.exe/.py add-on. The closed add-on binary was inspected as data only, never executed or bundled.

This fork instead implements optional AI chat natively in core/ai_chat.py and core/chat_window.py: off by default, explicit opt-in and disclosure, user-supplied key, no bundled key, no network before opt-in.
Upstream pulchra_prompt.txt is shipped as assets/pulchra_prompt.txt.
Menu item and head-tap shortcut Open Comms (AI Chat) were ported; all other artwork and configuration assets are byte-identical to 5.4.1.
The upstream Windows installer remains unbundled and was not executed.
6.0.0a source ZIP is byte-identical to 6.0.0; only the optional chat EXE changed. The EXE was statically inspected as data, never executed or bundled.

Static code comparison shows the add-on upgrade adds a Blazewood relay banner, green/gold chat styling, and separate action/speech colors. Network and fallback logic are unchanged apart from colored output. Ported the presentation to the native Tk chat, preserving literal text and optional/off-by-default behavior.
Upstream uses an encrypted-relay fictional label; the fork does not claim end-to-end encryption. No upstream keyless service or fallback was added; messages only go to the user-configured service.
